Thanks Dylan —

Great call. A few notes from procurement: we generally prefer PO for new vendors, but for small pilot work card on file is acceptable.

Who to send the packet to: procurement@acmeanalytics.com (Laura Bennett is the primary contact; she’ll triage). Our vendor portal is https://acmeanalytics.vendorportal.com/onboard — we use an in-house portal (no Ariba/Coupa).

Required items to start vendor setup: W-9 (or W-8 for non-US entities), vendor packet with company address and banking details (for ACH), and a signed vendor agreement if a formal contract is required. Typical payment terms are Net 30 after invoice.

We’re open to marketplace options (AWS Marketplace) but that requires an internal legal review and procurement approval; for now please proceed with direct vendor onboarding so we can start the pilot.

I’ve attached our onboarding form — fill out relevant sections and upload to our portal or email to procurement@acmeanalytics.com.

Attachments: Acme_W9.pdf (PDF), Acme_vendor_onboarding_form.docx (DOCX)
